review.name: Verdant Treant
findings: Fresh baseline six head and six full-body source slices across all thirteen clips and all 216 native equipped technique frames actually inspected. Lower wooden face and branch chin shear beneath leaf crown during secondary idle, recoil, victory and tilted defeat. Other body joints and trailing wraps remain connected. Separate complete-face binding candidate pending.

Separate second pass actually inspected all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, 32 production transition slices across low and medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 native equipped technique frames in twelve lossless strips and all sixteen atlas cells. All passed. Full geometry 203 poses per asset with zero warnings; original independent face landmarks and 468 blends pass. Separate central branch and upper leafy brow binding preserves sculpt, topology, textures, rig, all authored animation curves and 15319 protected vertex palettes. Eight focused regression/animation-bank tests and production build passed. Whole roster and live release pending.
